title: U.S. Inflation Eased at Start of the Year - The New York Times
snippet: Inflation in the United States eased at the start of 2026, providing a reprieve to the Federal Reserve as it contends with yet another year of consumer prices rising faster than the central bank’s target. * Overall inflation unexpectedly eased to 2.4 percent in January from the same time last year.
